definitions.gloss: driving the wrong way; going against traffic; wrong-way driving
definitions.explanation: Driving or running in the opposite direction of the designated flow, especially on highways or one-way roads. A serious traffic violation that frequently makes the news in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a car driving the wrong way on the expressway.

examples.japanese: {逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧な⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Wrong-way driving leads to serious accidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢|こうれい}→高齢：14648_kourei⟧⟦ドライバー→ドライバー：05478_doraibaa⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Wrong-way accidents by elderly drivers have become a social issue.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun and as a suru-verb ({逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Frequently appears in Japanese news, particularly regarding elderly driver incidents on expressways. Can also be used for running or cycling the wrong way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to drive the wrong way)
- {逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (wrong-way accident)
- {逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧ (wrong-way vehicle)
- {逆走|ぎゃくそう}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (prevention of wrong-way driving)
